about: Per Naver leaf category, title words that leave a listing row out before its page is read (listing_filter.Screen; the owner, 2026-11-11: what the shop's section does not sell). Matched on the title NFKC-normalized, lower case and without spaces; notFollowedBy / notPrecededBy as in listing_exclusions.json. Studied on the listings of 2026-11-11: 515 titles of 50002787 (46 of 56 that do not fit, none that fits), 351 of 50002788 (3 of 23 beside the rentals the shared file already drops). A rule may list `unless` words: any of them in the title and the rule does not apply. A rule names its code, which is the row's reason (title:<code>). 50002788 since 2026-11-14 is lenient (the owner: never lose a real product): only what is certainly not a set is left out (1,817 past titles: 5 left out, 3 published, the folding one-club products, no set; junior sets are not left out: no other job collects them, review_suspects.py lists them); the doubtful ones are published and listed by review_suspects.py. 50002670 (2026-11-14, women's iron sets): loose heads and shafts, a single iron (단품 with no set word) and a men's set (남성 with no women's word); a set whose gender no word states is left to placement (held).; a used or refurbished set (중고, 리퍼; 2026-11-15). 50002783 (2026-11-15, wedge sets; 670 titles of 골프 웨지 세트): loose heads and a wedge without its shaft, accessories (covers, grips, training aids, sharpeners), chippers, a used set, and a single wedge (웨지 with no set word or count; the owner: sets only). 2026-11-15, the visual lenses on 661 published junior sets (scripts/LENSES.md): toys, adult sets and two not-golf products added to 50002787's words (each measured on all 796 collected rows of the category, no real junior club hit); photo-only misfits stay for the lenses. 50002784 (2026-11-18, chippers; 1,260 titles of 골프 치퍼 and 치퍼 by price slices, 482 out): not-golf goods filed under chippers (garden wood chippers and their blades, air chisels, kitchen choppers, poker chips, bags), clothes and shoes, accessories and training aids, a putter with no chipper word (the owner: a double-sided chipper-putter stays), a wedge with no chipper or chipping word, and other clubs (irons, an agency's putters and hybrids keyworded 치퍼); every word checked on all 1,260 titles, no chipper hit; the review of 2026-11-18 (2,558 distinct titles of 18 queries by price slices) found 13 chipper listings wrongly out (아이언그레이, TUG019 / TUG071 keyword titles, a chipping putter, CH809 38°) and misfits kept: the escapes now take 칩퍼 / 치핑 / the PGM and World Eagle chipper codes / a 25-45° loft, and new rules leave out a club with no chipper word (drivers, woods, hybrids), an agency's hand-치퍼 titles without chipper evidence (agency_club) and a used club (used); every changed row read, no chipper lost. 2026-11-18, the review of the 100-chipper scroll: a loose chipper head or shaft (parts, as 50002670; 950 distinct titles, only the Acer XK head 12409532747 out). A rule may instead list `requires`: groups of words, each group needing one of its words in the title (2026-11-19). 50002797 (2026-11-19, women's golf knit cardigans; the owner): a women's word (여성, 여자, ladies, women) and a knit word (니트, 가디건, 카디건, knit, cardigan), and only cardigans: a title without 가디건 / 카디건 / cardigan is left out (pullovers, vests, sweaters, 2-piece sets, a padded jumper filed under knits); measured on the 96 titles of the listing 여성 골프 니트 가디건 (the scouts' sample, 2026-11-19): 30 kept, 63 not_womens, 3 not_cardigan (2-piece sets, a zip-up with no cardigan word); every kept title a women's cardigan; 우먼 (어뉴 우먼 ... 가디건) is not in the owner's women's words and is left out. 2026-11-20 (knit wave 1 review): jacket_no_knit, a jacket or windbreaker word with no 니트 / knit (a polyester windbreaker passed on 가디건 alone); on the wave's 108 titles it leaves out that one, the 14 knit zip-ups named 자켓 / 바람막이 / 점퍼 stay.
